title: Drug Interaction Intelligence
short: An interaction checker that explains clinical significance, not just a red warning.
problem: Classic checkers fire too many alerts and explain none of them.
why: Polypharmacy is rising; ignored alerts include the dangerous ones.
solution: Matches the full medication list against a curated knowledge base and explains each relevant interaction in plain language.
directions: Take with the full medication list. Explains mechanism, severity and what to do — in English or Arabic.
data: Patient factors (age, renal and hepatic function)
review: The pharmacist decides on management and communicates with the prescriber.
